external_rechecks.fixture: B8 vs K27 · Tesla Cup Group A
external_rechecks.observed: B8 62¢ · K27 39¢; $4.65K volume; market text: "initially scheduled for October 27, 2026 at 4:00 AM ET"
external_rechecks.note: The 62¢ leg equals the published 62.0%; the two legs sum to 101¢ because they are the ask sides of a 1¢-wide book, and the published number is the no-vig midpoint. The 4:00 AM ET start renders as 09:00 on the site because Europe/Malta moves off summer time on 25 October, so the displayed hour is correct, not an hour off.
